messages.content:
CRITICAL EXACT SPELLING: "Chain Table (CT)", "Target Table (TT)", "Iteration Stride Tracker (IST)", "IMAD.WIDE", "LDG.E", "SpMV"

Render a publication-quality academic diagram for MICRO/ISCA/HPCA. 16:9, 7.0" IEEE. NO title. NO shadows. NO gradients. White background.

This is iteration 3. CRITICAL FIXES from iteration 2:
1. CT column group labels must say ONLY the group NAME ("Identification", "Target Mapping", "Stride Learning") with NO hex color codes visible. The light background tint is a background fill color, NOT text to display.
2. CT->TT convergence arrows must be VERY THICK (2-3pt), the thickest lines in the entire figure.
3. TT header must be CLEARLY PURPLE/VIOLET (distinctly different shade from CT's blue).

=== LAYOUT ===
Upper-left: SpMV CUDA code (gray box). Upper-right: SASS Assembly (gray box).
Formula bar in middle. Lower-left (~65%): CT. Lower-right top: TT. Lower-right bottom: IST.

=== SpMV CODE (upper-left, gray #F5F5F5 box) ===
"SpMV CUDA Kernel" label.
  // CSR SpMV (base.cu:22)
  for (int offset = row_begin;
       offset < row_end; offset++) {
    sum += Ax[offset] * x[Aj[offset]];
  }
"Aj[offset]" blue underline "Index Load". "x[...]" amber underline "Data Load".

=== SASS ASSEMBLY (upper-right, gray #F5F5F5 box) ===
"SASS Assembly (x16 Unrolled Loop)" label. Three groups with colored right-margin brackets:

Blue bracket "IMA Index Loads":
  *0x03d0* LDG.E R9, [R6+-0x8]
  *0x03e0* LDG.E R27, [R6+-0x4]
  ... (13 more)

Purple bracket "Addr Generation":
  *0x0480* IMAD.WIDE R8, R9, R16, c[0x180]
  *0x0490* IMAD.WIDE R26, R27, R16, c[0x180]
  ... (14 more)

Amber bracket "IMA Data Loads":
  *0x04a0* LDG.E R14, [R8]
  *0x04c0* LDG.E R24, [R26]
  ... (14 more)
  *0x0580* FFMA R14, R14, R18, R11

=== FORMULA ===
Addr_target = base + scale x index (base and scale in purple, index in blue)

=== CHAIN TABLE (CT) — BLUE header ===
Header: solid blue fill, white bold text "Chain Table (CT)" and "32 entries".

Three column GROUPS, each with a short group label and light pastel background fill (NOT hex codes, just the visual color):
- "Identification" group (very light blue background): columns V, Index PC
- "Target Mapping" group (very light lavender background): columns tt_idx[0], [1], [2], K
- "Stride Learning" group (very light yellow background): columns Iter Stride, Stride Valid

Data:
Row 0: green-square | 0x03d0 | 0 | - | - | 1 | 64 B | TRUE
Row 1: green-square | 0x03e0 | 0 | - | - | 1 | 64 B | TRUE
Row 2: green-square | 0x0A20 | 0 | 1 | - | 2 | 16 B | TRUE
... (gray ellipsis)

=== TARGET TABLE (TT) — PURPLE/VIOLET header (NOT blue!) ===
Header: solid purple/violet fill (clearly different from CT blue), white bold text "Target Table (TT)" and "8 entries".

Columns: Idx | V | Base Address | Scale | Type
Row 0: 0 | green-sq | c[0x0][0x180] | 4B | f32
Row 1: 1 | green-sq | 0x7FC4B7E40000 | 4B | f32
Row 2: 2 | green-sq | 0x7FC4B8100000 | 8B | f64
Row 3: 3 | gray-dash | — | — | —

Below: "CAM: lookup by (base, scale)" italic.

=== IST BLOCK (blue outline, white fill) ===
Title "Iteration Stride Tracker (IST)" bold.
  PC 0x03d0, Warp 0:
  iter i: A1 = 0x7FC4D0DA4864
  iter i+1: A2 = 0x7FC4D0DA48A4
  stride = A2 - A1 = 0x40 = 64 B
"Any warp can contribute" italic.
Arrow left to CT stride column.

=== ARROWS ===
1. SASS->CT: Black solid, circles 1 and 2. "CD detects chain" label.
2. CT->TT: THREE VERY THICK (2-3pt) BLACK arrows from CT tt_idx[0] pointing RIGHT to TT Row 0. These arrows CONVERGE. Bold annotation: "16 CT entries -> 1 TT entry". THESE ARE THE THICKEST, MOST PROMINENT LINES IN THE FIGURE.
3. SASS->TT: Gray dashed from IMAD.WIDE operands to TT.
4. IST->CT: Thin arrow left.

=== LEGEND ===
Bottom: blue square "Storage" | purple square "Logic" | white square "External" | solid line arrow "Training path" | dashed "Index PF" | dashed "Data PF"
